bull.b: Sustained high growth indicates strong demand for Cloudflare’s security, performance and developer services. The recurring subscription model, broad product portfolio and enterprise expansion can support durable revenue scaling over the next several quarters.

High retention and growing enterprise adoption show that customers are expanding usage rather than merely being added. This supports recurring revenue visibility, cross-selling across products and a stronger position with larger, more valuable accounts.

Improving free cash flow provides internal funding for network investment and product development. Government security certifications also expand access to regulated customers, creating a durable channel for integrated security and infrastructure services.

bear.b: Despite strong revenue and non-GAAP earnings, recurring GAAP operating losses indicate that durable bottom-line profitability has not yet been established. Continued losses may constrain financial quality and increase dependence on equity-based compensation or financing.

Leverage is high for a software company and reduces flexibility if growth slows or investment needs rise. Although Cloudflare has substantial liquidity, modest debt coverage leaves the business more sensitive to refinancing, execution and funding risks.

Higher network costs, elevated infrastructure spending and organizational charges can suppress operating leverage while Cloudflare scales. If usage growth requires continued heavy investment, margin recovery and the conversion of revenue growth into durable earnings may be delayed.
